title: Recoverable Errors with Result
text: Rust represents recoverable errors with Result<T, E>. The question mark operator propagates errors to the calling function. Functions that can fail commonly return Result and callers can match on Ok and Err.

title: std::result::Result
text: Result is a type that represents either success Ok(T) or failure Err(E). It is used for returning and propagating errors. Methods include map, and_then, unwrap_or, and the question mark operator integrates with Try.

title: What Is Ownership?
text: Ownership is Rust's system for memory safety without a garbage collector. Values have owners and are dropped when the owner goes out of scope.
